title: 4 BDR Stay for 12 w/Rooftop Patio Firepit! Near DT
description:
✔️ East Nashville location — minutes to Downtown and Five Points
✔️ Rooftop deck with city views, wet bar, and fire pit
✔️ 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths + 2 half baths — sleeps 12
✔️ Full kitchen with wine cooler, Keurig + drip coffee
✔️ Smart TV, board games, workspace, and fast Wi‑Fi
✔️ Pet friendly for 1 dog; gated front and back yards

The space
• Skyline Social East is built for group time and easy city access
• Start with coffee in the bright kitchen, then explore breweries and brunch spots
• Gather for dinner, stream a favorite in the comfy living room
• Cap the night with rooftop cocktails by the fire pit and skyline views
• Note: The living room fireplace is out of service until further notice

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Spacious living room with sectional and smart TV (fireplace out of service)
• Rooftop lounge with wet bar, outdoor seating, fire pit, and skyline views
• Gated front and back yards for added peace of mind
• Board games and a laptop‑friendly workspace
• Central heat/AC and in‑home washer/dryer

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 12)
• This home includes 4 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and 2 half bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 — Twin‑over‑queen bunk with twin trundle; desk; sleeps 4
• Bedroom 2 — King bed; desk; ensuite with single vanity and shower/tub combo; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 3 — King bed; ensuite with single vanity and oversized shower/tub combo; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 4 — King bed; smart TV; ensuite with dual vanities, soaking tub, and glass walk‑in shower; sleeps 2
• Living Room — Full‑size sleeper sofa; sleeps 2
• Additional Baths — Hall bath with shower/tub combo; two hall half baths

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Fully equipped kitchen with stainless appliances and ample counter space
• Coffee duo: Keurig and drip coffeemaker; full‑size wine cooler
• Dining table seating 8; island seating 3
• Cookware, bakeware, utensils, are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• In‑unit/home washer and dryer for longer stays
• We provide bedding, towels and a small starter set of essentials
• Smart TV, board games, and Wi‑Fi
• Rooftop wet bar, fire pit, and outdoor seating

📍 Location Highlights
• East Nashville breweries, restaurants, and coffee shops — moments away
• Five Points — dining, bars, and music venues nearby
• Downtown/Broadway — honky‑tonks and live music minutes by rideshare
• Nissan Stadium — games and shows across the river
• Shelby Park & Greenway — biking, birding, and river views

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Garage + fenced driveway parking for up to 3 vehicles
• Stairs: Multilevel home; stairs required for bedrooms and rooftop access
• Fireplace: Out of service until further notice
• Outdoor space: Gated front and back yards
• Security: Three exterior cameras — rear of garage (driveway), front door (entry/sidewalk), rooftop deck (deck); exterior/common areas only
• Pets: One dog allowed; $75 fee. Add your pet at booking if available or contact Guest Experience to process the fee; pets must be crated/contained when left alone; additional cleaning/damage fees may apply
• Check‑in 4:00 PM; checkout 10:00 AM
